source_label: Huddleston & Pullum et al., The Cambridge Grammar of the English Language (Cambridge University Press, 2002): chapter and section structure only
assumptions: Every example sentence, analysis and explanation is original and authored for this page; none is reproduced from the book.
The analyses follow the framework and terminology of the book as understood by the author; they were reviewed against it, but the page is not endorsed by the authors or publisher.
Chapter and section references come from the publisher's contents pages. A concept cites only the chapter when its section could not be verified, and page numbers are section start pages only.
Main-clause interrogatives with subject-auxiliary inversion are described in text but not drawn as trees in this version.
